**q25** — Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) in `internal/filter` (`engine.go:24` `NewEngine`, `parser.go`, `schema.go`, `ir.go`, `render.go`). Mechanism: the engine compiles the CEL filter into a dialect-agnostic condition/IR tree, then `render.go` emits dialect-specific SQL + args (switching on `DialectSQLite` / `DialectPostgres` / `DialectMySQL`, e.g. `render.go:231-237`), invoked from each driver's `ListMemos` via `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.Dialect*, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`).

**q26** — `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (memo rows for the comment memos and then the memo itself) — `store/memo.go:140-160`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:568-580`. `memo_share` is removed by the `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK on `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:108`, `sqlite/LATEST.sql:107`) — note SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so the cascade is not enforced there. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but not deleted.

Unused-infra note: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron-expression job scheduler, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`) is not referenced anywhere outside its own package — the server never uses it. Also `server/runner/memopayload` is not a scheduled runner; it's only called inline from the memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**q29** — Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:147` (attached to the Connect transport at `web/src/connect.ts:172-177`). Tokens it manages: a short-lived JWT **access token** sent as `Authorization: Bearer …` (stored/refreshed via `web/src/auth-state.ts`), refreshed on 401 or preflight expiry through the **refresh token** HTTP-only cookie `memos_refresh` (`credentials: "include"`, `refreshAuthClient.refreshToken`, `web/src/connect.ts:71`); Personal Access Tokens (`memos_pat_…`) are also accepted on the same Bearer header. Backend validation: package `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/token.go`), invoked via `NewAuthInterceptor(authorizer)` / `Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:213` and `server/router/api/v1/authz.go`.
